missing_requirements: No universal receiver contract or complete field registry.
Other bt variants and generic banner profiles remain outside selection.
Issued account IDs, tracking authenticity, event sequencing and delivery require external state.
Unknown future types/custom values and ambiguous repeated discriminators remain open.
Single requests do not prove the integration has an Impression event or a varying cachebuster.

Cross-field conditions compare value-bearing scalars through the existing extractor. Bare type/custom query keys are omitted, so a separate known literal mismatch can still warn. No receiver duplicate-selection policy is asserted. Explicit bare-key controls retain this diagnostic boundary.

Documented protocol-relative URLs need an external page/base URL before validation. This absolute-URL engine keeps the unresolved form core-only and reports its existing invalid-URL finding. Vendor permission to use HTTP does not suppress the existing core insecure-transport warning.
